description: This file contains concrete implementations of generic grain interfaces in a Orleans project, defining classes that implement interface methods with specific type parameters.

classes.name: ConcreteGrainWithGenericInterfaceOfIntFloat
classes.description: Implements the generic grain interface IGenericGrain with int and float type parameters, providing methods to set and map the generic type.

classes.name: ConcreteGrainWithGenericInterfaceOfFloatString
classes.description: Implements the generic grain interface IGenericGrain with float and string type parameters, providing methods to set and map the generic type.

classes.name: ConcreteGrainWith2GenericInterfaces
classes.description: Implements multiple interfaces: IGenericGrain with int and string, and ISimpleGenericGrain with int, providing methods for setting, transforming, retrieving, and comparing grains.

methods.name: SetT
methods.description: Sets the internal generic value T (int or float).

methods.name: MapT2U
methods.description: Maps the internal value T to another type (float or string) and returns it asynchronously.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the value of T for ISimpleGenericGrain implementation.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms the value T internally, e.g., multiplies by 10.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of T.

methods.name: CompareGrainReferences
methods.description: Method to compare grain references; currently throws NotImplementedException.
